record.notes: This number is better than every third-party H100 spot rate found and it is measurable with no account, which makes it the reference point the rest of the class should be judged against. It is also 2.8 times cheaper than Verda's flat 50 per cent H100 spot at USD 2.235. The risk is entirely in the dynamic clause: the range ceiling is one cent under USD 4.50, so a run without a pricing policy has unbounded cost, and a pricing policy that caps it converts the price risk into a stop. H100 is single-region (eu-north1), so there is no region to move to when the price rises. qualifies-with-caveat via a05-spot. The one recorded is the better-evidenced.
